steps.title: Sort the neighbors
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `more flash:peering.txt`. One neighbor is in another AS, one in ours. Answer with `submit EBGP=...` and `submit IBGP=...`.

steps.title: Bring up both sessions
steps.body: Go to `conf t`, then `router bgp 65010`. Add `neighbor 203.0.113.1 remote-as 64500` and `neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65010`. Advertise the Grid: `network 192.168.0.0 mask 255.255.0.0`. Then `end` and `show ip bgp summary`: both neighbors should show a prefix count, not Idle or Active.

objectives.label: iBGP session to the Citadel configured
Checked both sessions with show ip bgp summary

steps.title: Fix the next-hop trap
steps.body: Run `show ip bgp neighbors 10.0.0.2 advertised-routes`: everything Skyport passes to the Citadel says next hop 203.0.113.1. Back in `router bgp 65010`, add `neighbor 10.0.0.2 next-hop-self`, then check the same command again.

objectives.label: Confirmed the Citadel now gets next hop 10.0.0.1
